style: photoreal practical-prop science-fiction cinema; cold blue to warm golden light
constraints: consistent robot silhouette and worn materials
same seated pose across time jump
no watermark or photographic title text

assets.brief: Original maintenance robot R-07 identity sheet: worn ivory enamel, single amber eye, navy shoulder triangle, three-finger hands, removable orange chest cartridge.
Wide cold Mars corridor, recycling hatch, robot notices last dying greenhouse seedling. Orange battery in chest.
Macro chest battery insert, clear 1% meter, hand at latch, cold blue light.
Fragile frosted drooping two-leaf seedling in terracotta pot, heater dark, robot eye blurred through glass.
Battery already removed: empty chest, one orange cartridge in hand beside empty heater socket.
Same cartridge installed in heater, hand withdrawing, amber overhead lamp now on.
Robot seated beside greenhouse wall, empty chest, dim eye, open right palm; warmed seedling and orange heater battery at right.
Closeup of bowed robot head with eye fully dark and chest empty; warm plant blurred behind.
Matching exact seated composition years later, robot unpowered and weathered, flourishing white flowering vines, flower growing in open palm.
Closing macro of white flower growing from soil in stationary mechanical palm, dark eye and empty chest blurred behind.
Remove the hand and forearm only; unobstructed orange chest battery and crisp 1% meter; camera, identity and light preserved. Selected final keyframe.
Remove all robot parts from foreground only; unchanged installed orange cartridge, bent seedling, amber heater and greenhouse. Selected final keyframe.

Tighter flower macro; all fingertips/joints cropped outside frame. Same dew-covered white flower, concave metal palm surface and blurred dark eye/empty chest. Negative space for closing title. Selected final keyframe.
